title: Swiss Common Breeding Bird Monitoring (MHB) 1999-2025: territory counts per visit of 157 bird species on 267 1-km squares, without the turtle dove, coordinates as published
creator: Strebel, Nicolas; Wechsler, Samuel; Buehler, Roman; Haefliger, Guido; Keller, Verena; Kery, Marc; Rogenmoser, Christian; Spiess, Martin; Varga, Katarina; Volet, Bernard; Zbinden, Niklaus; Schmid, Hans (Swiss Ornithological Institute)
citation: Strebel, N., Wechsler, S., Buehler, R., Haefliger, G., Keller, V., Kery, M., Rogenmoser, C., Spiess, M., Varga, K., Volet, B., Zbinden, N. & Schmid, H. (2026). Supplementary material for «Data of the Swiss Common Breeding Bird Monitoring Program» [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18480886. Data paper: Strebel, N. et al. (2025). Data of the Swiss common breeding bird monitoring program. Ecology 106(12): e70268. https://doi.org/10.1002/ecy.70268
abstract: The Swiss Common Breeding Bird Monitoring (MHB) of the Swiss Ornithological Institute surveys 267 1-km squares on a systematic grid across Switzerland (250-2750 m) every breeding season since 1999 by simplified territory mapping. This table carries the detection histories: the number of territories found occupied at each visit, for N-mixture and occupancy models. A species is counted at a visit only when the visit falls after its species-specific date limit, and per-visit values are missing where the maps were not digitised (mostly before 2013); __survey_taxa lists the species counted at each visit.
samplingProtocol: Simplified territory mapping (Swiss Common Breeding Bird Monitoring, MHB): one skilled observer walks a fixed 4-6 km route through a 1-km square in early morning in good weather, three visits per breeding season (two above the timberline) within 4-6 weeks between mid-April and early July, mapping every bird seen or heard; records meeting species-specific breeding-period and behaviour criteria are grouped into territories (manually, by Autoterri since 2022).
closureNote: visits within one breeding season (4-6 weeks at a square), assumed closed; territories may change between years (period)
surveyEvidenceNote: The survey list is header-species-count.csv (one row per conducted and accepted square-year, with n_visits); every visit of every listed square-year has a value for some species (asserted). __survey_taxa (taxon, unit, period, occasion) lists the species counted at each visit: a NA value is not surveyed for that species, because the visit is before the species' date limit (visit 1, or visits 1-2, for late breeders), the mapping data are not digital (all visits NA: 39,211 species x square-years), or the record is not valid (188, total also NA).
surveyTaxaNote: __survey_taxa (taxon, unit, period, occasion): the species counted at each visit; visits outside a species' counting window, square-years whose maps are not digital, and invalid records are absent.
geographicCoverage: Switzerland, 267 1-km squares of the Swiss Biodiversity Monitoring grid (CH1903+ / LV95), 250-2750 m a.s.l.
crs: unit_decimalLatitude / unit_decimalLongitude: WGS84 (EPSG:4326); unit_x / unit_y: CH1903+ / LV95 (EPSG:2056); square centroids

coordinatesCoarsened.method: as published (centroids of the 1-km squares, uncertainty 707 m, the half-diagonal); the flagged European turtle dove (Streptopelia turtur, IUCN VU) is not in this table (E7.3); the coarsened table with every species is strebel_2026_swiss_mhb_count

notShipped.n_recorded_species: header-species-count.csv: the number of species with a positive total at the survey; a count of the total column (asserted), not an observation
notShipped.visit_dates: not deposited (no visit dates or durations in the release)
notShipped.territories_total: the season total is strebel_2026_swiss_mhb_total_count (36530 positive totals have no per-visit values; ruling 2026-11-06, E1)
notShipped.never_recorded_per_visit: Lanius senator, Passer hispaniolensis, Acanthis flammea, Emberiza hortulana: no positive per-visit value in any survey (positive totals only: Acanthis flammea 1,249, Passer hispaniolensis 213, Lanius senator 1, Emberiza hortulana 1), so not recorded in this table (taxonInclusion = recorded); they are in the season-total tables
notShipped.STRTUR: the European turtle dove (IUCN VU) is left out of this precise-coordinate table (E7.3); it is in strebel_2026_swiss_mhb_count with coarsened coordinates

notes: Two tables per E7 pair from one deposit (ruling 2026-11-06, per-visit series and season total): the per-visit counts and the season totals; the other is strebel_2026_swiss_mhb_total_count (season territory totals per square-year). 36530 positive season totals (33407 at three-visit squares) have no per-visit values. Metadata S1 says that where no territory resulted the visits were set to 0 whatever the species' date limit, so some visit-1 zeros of late breeders may precede the limit; most such rows keep the NA in this release. Two square-years (2008, 2009) have visit 2 NA and visit 1 kept for 41 late-breeder rows, as deposited. Positive totals over all-zero visits (3,432) concentrate in a few species (Acanthis flammea 1,070, Passer domesticus 923, Poecile montanus 374, Passer hispaniolensis 198), whose per-visit series may be incomplete; Acanthis flammea and Passer hispaniolensis have no positive per-visit value at all and are not in this table. Four sensitive species are withheld by the source (taxaWithheld). Taxon codes are genus+epithet initials as in kery_2014_mhb_comm (BirdLife names; Curruca for Sylvia communis / curruca). Overlap: kery_2014_mhb_comm (AHMbook::MHB2014) and the kery single-species MHB tables are subsets of the same scheme from other deposits; this release is the scheme's own, 1999-2025.
